spans.s: greedy, covetous, avaricious, desirous of or longing for (loc. or comp.), Gaut.; MBh. &c.
लुब्ध—जन mfn. having covetous followers, MW.
लुब्ध—जातके वर्ष-वर्धापन-विधान n. N. of wk.
लुब्ध—ता f. greediness, covetousness, ardent desire for (loc.), Rājat.; Kathās.
लुब्ध—त्व n. greediness, covetousness, ardent desire for (loc.), Rājat.; Kathās.
a covetous or greedy man, L.

the star Sirius (so called because Śiva in the form of a hunter shot an arrow [represented by the three stars in the belt of Orion] at Brahmā transformed into a deer and pursuing his own daughter metamorphosed into a doe; cf. मृग-व्याध), Gaṇit.; Kathās.
N. of the hinder parts, BhP.
